provenance.audit_note: 2026-08-27 (audit-remediation Wave J1). Both columns in every entry below are labelled `no_verifiable_source`. They are presented as computed quantum-chemistry results - wB97M-V and revDSD-PBEP86-D4 barrier heights - but the repository contains no input deck, no output log, no geometry, no basis-set or solvation specification, and no run date for any of them. A computed number with no reproducible run behind it is an assertion, not a calculation.
provenance.why_not_verified: These cannot be anchored to a primary source even in principle: they are not literature values, they are claimed to be this project's own calculations. The only thing that could verify them is re-running them. Until someone does, `no_verifiable_source` is the honest label.
provenance.fabrication_indicators: revDSD-PBEP86-D4 minus wB97M-V, over all nine families: +0.5, 0.0, +0.4, +0.5, +0.6, +0.4, +0.6, +0.3, +0.5 kcal/mol. Every difference is non-negative, every one is a clean multiple of 0.1, and all nine lie in a 0.6 kcal/mol band. Two genuinely independent functionals do not agree that tidily or that one-sidedly across nine different reaction classes; the spread of a real double-hybrid-vs-range-separated-hybrid comparison is both wider and signed in both directions. The `wb97mv_kcal_mol` column is byte-identical to the column of the same name in phase33_barrier_benchmarks.json, whose own defects are recorded there.
provenance.runtime_coupling: NONE, verified 2026-08-27 - see the same field in phase33_barrier_benchmarks.json. Nothing in src/ consumes these values; the only importer is a loader test.
